My thing is though, that the Promo innate powers have by and large addressed a shortcoming of sorts. Bunkers two promo illustrate this simply. EoW adds to his lack of ongoing destruction, and GI helps strong aversion toward DR. Young Legacy added missing damage potential. Golem Unity added play speed. Dark Visionary frees up her Play phase for more damage oriented cards instead of support ones. Haka and Ra gain card cycling. Redeemer Fanatic gained minor mitigation and speed some speed.

PW Fanatic would raise the ceiling on Martyr to 8 sure, but its still a 1:1 damage ratio. Thats a big "meh" for me. What is interesting is that Zealous Offense would not require Absolution be in play to keep ZO around. Taking 3 damage yourself so 2 noncharacter targets cant deal damage may not be a terrible trade off if you need to keep some spaceships or Char from ripping you to shreds. And since she is a Prime Warden, of course any extra power useage, Embolden or otherwise, will never be wasted on Argent Adept.

 

Ideas for the other known Prime Warden promo powers:

Argent Adept - Reveal the top card of your deck until a Song is found. Activate either its Perform or Accompany text. Shuffle that Song back into your deck. 

Haka - Reduce all damage dealt to hero targets by Environment cards by 1. Draw a card.

Tempest - Place 2 cards from your hand under Tempest's Character card. Increase all Lightning damage Tempest deals by 1 for every 2 cards under this card.

[Redacted] - Something something something energy damage. Thats my best guess.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
It's not that they're annoying, they specifically release information that he should not be releasing.  For example, the latest one:

[Redacted] is not a Prime Warden. And yeah, we know her name too.

All indications are that he's talking about the giant Thorathian girl, and he's telling the world that she's not a Prime Warden.  That's not his info to divulge, and he's specifically agreed not to divulge stuff like that, yet he does it all the time.  I've got nothing personal against McBehrer and don't really want him to be banned from the forums, but anyone who consistently leaks little bits of info like this is breaking their agreement and should probably have their playtester priveleges revoked.  It's just an observation however, since I don't have any skin in that game.

Foote, telling people to "get over it" is pretty rude.  There are probably more harmonious ways to indicate that you're not bothered by something without telling people how they should feel about it, yes?
